def: formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula)

occurrences.text: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
